{{Top|leg}}
'''Permaplast''' was a building material. It was a relatively strong material that could take the weight of foot traffic and [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]]. The entry ramp into the crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[ProfitSmasher]]'' was made of permaplast and scrap metal.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>

Permaplast could also be used to create windows has seen in the new Darth Sidious quarters on Coruscant one month following the start of the jedi purge, and birth of the Galactic Empire.
